name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.281.0 — Test expiry never cuts a span it cannot bound: expire-tests --apply checks every retired case and emptied describe before cutting (ends on its own paren, closes at its opening indent, holds no foreign case or describe); an unbounded one stays in its file under a new unscannable list with one stderr line, while bounded neighbours are still cut, and a file is deleted only when no line-start case or describe is left. The test-call scanner no longer reads a JSX </ or /> as a regex, so closing and self-closing tags in .tsx tests retire cleanly instead of eating a describe's closing brace. 7.280.0 — spec-queue treats a path-shaped free-text item (a prototype contract in the plan lane) as an identity: two different paths are never near-duplicates, so prototype-driver --mark tests-derived no longer dies when another prototype's contract is pending; an identical path is still refused and groom pairs no two distinct paths. 7.279.0 — Prototype replay on split contracts and separate web boots: the build driver derives REPLAY only for the spec whose File Plan owns prototype.e2eFile ({stem} substituted) — the row /spec:plan already gives exactly one spec per contract — so sibling slices of one contract go straight to COMMIT with a one-line skip notice, refuse --mark replayed, and record replay:{owner:false}; review-legs appends no contract leg for them, so a stray [oracle: contract] AC on a sibling still reads absent. That row is no longer a wave row (the driver copies it at --mark replayed). The grounding contract gains optional prototype.bootCommand (falls back to runtime.bootCommand), printed by the REPLAY, ROUND and TESTS steps, for hosts whose smoke boot is an API-only process beside a web build; prototype-driver check flags a host with neither. Seen in prax-app spec 20261028/02; pinned by build-driver-replay.test.js plus contract-leg and prototype-driver cases.
